text:
Mia Chen: Quick async standup — rolling a dryrun for the feature-flag `new-routing` today at 10:30 PT. TL;DR: validated infra + smoke tests passed on slice-1, saw a flaky 502 on slice-3. Blocking ask: ops help to hold slice-3 at 0% until we triage. @Samir Patel @Alex Torres @Nina Park
Samir Patel: Saw the 502 in the logs, looks like upstream connection reset. I pushed a temporary backend retry tweak to the canary config. Will monitor.
Alex Torres: Thanks Samir. Can you paste the exact curl/replication steps? I couldn't repro locally.
Samir Patel: Repro steps: `curl -H "X-FF:new-routing:1" https://api.redwood.test/route -v` — does it for me 1/10 requests from slice-3. Logs show `upstream reset by peer`.
Nina Park: Noted. I'm on standby to pull traces. Mia, do we want to pause overall ramp at 2% or hold only slice-3?
Mia Chen: Hold only slice-3 at 0% for now. Keep slice-1/2 at 2% so we can validate the rest of the traffic. If latency or errors spike elsewhere, we abort and roll back.
deploy-bot: deploy started: dryrun/new-routing -> canary slices [1,2,3] @ 10:30 PT. ID: dr-2026-2199998765.
Alex Torres: I'll run a targeted smoke against slice-3 with `kubectl logs -l slice=slice-3 -n rdw` and attach traces here.
Samir Patel: FYI pushed a rollback knob: `ff:new-routing:force-off` in staging so we can kill if needed.
Nina Park: Traces coming in — initial look: a backend pool (gp-infer-07) returned 502s and then connections timed out. I'm tearing down that pod and routing away from it now.
Mia Chen: Perfect. Once that pod is drained, increase slice-3 to 0.5% for 15m and watch error budget. If errors <0.3% we resume to 2%.
Alex Torres: I refreshed canary config: increased healthy backends and bumped connection timeout to 60s. Will wait for 5m warm-up then step to 0.5%.
Samir Patel: Monitoring dashboards show errors dropping after the pod drain. No other anomalies so far. :thumbsup:
Mia Chen: Thanks all. Blockers summary: backend gp-infer-07 causing 502s — pod drained, retry policy applied. Next steps: 0.5% step for slice-3 in 5m, ops to watch latency and error budget. Ping here ASAP if anything weird.
Nina Park: A/V: I'll capture the span IDs and paste them if anything recurs.
Samir Patel: Tagging @eng-sre for visibility.
Mia Chen: If anyone needs to pause the dryrun, post `pause dr-2026-2199998765` here and deploy-bot will acknowledge.
